title: Teach once: the Owner turns a choice on a draft into a house rule, and matching drafts arrive pre-checked with the rule named
description: The master plan's first hard pass (2026-11-11): approvals are the bottleneck (34 drafts waiting on one person), so the cheapest way to raise results per owner minute is to stop asking the same question twice. When the Owner approves, edits or rejects a draft, the CEO can ask "handle ones like this the same way?"; a yes saves a house rule the Owner can read, edit or delete. A rule is { decision approve or reject, text up to 280 characters, match } where match names one or more of channel, hunt_id, niche, area and is compared for equality with the draft, so matching is plain code and never a model guess. Drafts waiting for the Owner that a rule matches carry suggest { decision, rule_id, rule }; the Owner applies a rule to a batch in one call, and a batch that names any draft the rule does not match changes nothing. A suggestion never changes a status or writes to the outbox: nothing auto-sends at any dial. The home number becomes owner minutes this week: distinct minutes in the last 7 days in which the Owner decided at least one draft, read from fwd's own records. Routes: POST/GET /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/rules, POST .../rules/{id}/edit and /delete, POST .../drafts/batch; GET /v1/supervisor gains owner_minutes. The Today and drafts screens show the pre-checked batch with the rule named; the site and relay buttons are a later row. Wave 2 of the master plan v2.
acceptance: POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/rules saves a rule; no session 401, unknown flow 404, an empty or unknown match key, unknown decision or bad text 400
A waiting draft a rule matches carries suggest with the rule id and text; others carry suggest null; statuses and the outbox are untouched
POST .../drafts/batch applies the rule to every named draft, or changes nothing and answers 400 when one does not match
Rules can be edited and deleted and survive a restart; a deleted rule suggests nothing
GET /v1/supervisor owner_minutes.week is 0 on a fresh home and counts the minutes with an Owner decision
